authority.acceptedContract: Creator is the saved-mission holder who is at that moment owner or admin of the workspace that owns the request AND the requester of the request the report was delivered for. One currently reviewed SELECT, DECLINE or NEED_INFORMATION disclosure; exact-fields preview; six fields only (company, decision, rationale, next action, due date, one provenance label); never a quotation, price, contact, file, another decision or requirement text. Digest only: every read re-derives live and answers one uniform 'unknown' on any change. A 43-character token in the URL fragment of /decision-card (POST body); only its SHA-256 is stored. The same command retried returns the same card. At most 7 days and never beyond the earlier of the delivery link expiry and the retention end of every source. Read-only, no-store, no-referrer, noindex; GET and HEAD never disclose. Only the creator can withdraw. At most 5 active cards per saved report. The creator sees an open count (page loads, which may include automatic link checks) and the last-opened time. Cards exist for SAMPLE (synthetic) workspaces only; real workspaces always answer unknown. Enabling is an owner action needing the recorded privacy review and the installed module.

databaseModule.summary: Three append-only tables in customer_private with RLS and immutability triggers, no policy, no CREATE OR REPLACE. Twelve new functions: five granted to corridra_runtime with EXECUTE only and seven helpers granted to nobody. Own registry table customer_decision_card_migrations, advisory lock, multi-file hash-guarded installer, error 'Customer decision card migration history mismatch'. The installer first runs the prerequisite migrators for decisions, delivery, organisation profiles and member roles.
grantedFunctions: customer.decision_card_state(uuid): resourceId, canShare, maxActive, and the caller's own cards (id, decisionId, state ACTIVE|WITHDRAWN|EXPIRED|UNAVAILABLE, createdAt, expiresAt, opens, lastOpenedAt); live cards (ACTIVE and UNAVAILABLE) are listed first and always
customer.create_decision_card(command, resource, decision, expected_digest, token_hash, expected_expires default null)
app.read_decision_card(h): takes the SHA-256 hex of the token; returns {state:'unknown'} or {state:'OPEN', card, expiresAt, synthetic:true}
errorConstants: 23514 'DECISION_CARD_CHANGED': stale digest, changed retry or stale shown expiry
54000 'DECISION_CARD_RATE_LIMITED': the 31st new card per actor and saved report per hour

acceptedBehaviours: A card validates only the CHOSEN decision: it stays OPEN when another decision in the same disclosure lapses (unlike customer.saved_mission_decisions). Recorded in the SQL comments.
A creator who is demoted and then re-promoted revives the same link (heal); a changed field never heals. Recorded in the SQL comments.

The stored token_hash is a bearer credential for app.read_decision_card, the same pattern as the delivery link. A database read plus AUTH_SECRET regenerates every link, so command ids that carry tokens must never be logged.
UNAVAILABLE cards count toward the cap of 5 (stricter); UNAVAILABLE cards can be withdrawn.
Timing is not claimed identical beyond the response body.
53400 is also used by admission functions and 23514 by other validation, so a route must map the 409 reason by message text and not by SQLSTATE alone.

review: One adversarial read-only review (corridra-reviewer) found no blocking or security defect. It traced every authority edge, token handling, the cap under 8 concurrent creates, grants, RLS, immutability, the prerequisite guard and the installer, and found them sound. Items fixed in 54af3c4: a sleep-based expiry test, 168 hours, the hourly cap, list ordering, and eight missing tests (disabled principal, padded hash, duplicate token hash, expected_expires above 7 days or above the resolved expiry, exact retry after withdrawal and after demotion, withdraw after the report was removed, the withdrawn event payload carrying no digest or token, a non-UTC session). The review result is relayed by the conductor and builder; no review file exists in the repository.
